candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Classic Ketogenic Diet: Patients will adhere to a classic ketogenic diet for a period of 3 months with a possible extension depending on their compliance on the diet. (interventions: Other: CKD)

coder_notes: Ketogenic diet trial (phase NA); a diet is an excluded intervention type (section 1.2) and not a drug, so no agent rows. Population: glioblastoma plus brain metastases (other primary cancers) -> coded basket_gbm_eligible; mixed_glioma_gbm_named is an alternative reading but either way glioblastoma is eligible. 'Glioblastoma grade 4' without IDH or WHO reference coded cns5_terminology unclear (could be read as historical). Setting 'both' because eligibility admits newly diagnosed GBM or progression after prior therapy (the progression clause may apply only to metastases).
